initial.text: Build a wider jug with a chunkier handle.

steps.text: Add a cylinder.
Vertices 20: smooth enough for a round mug.
steps.help: Vertices in the Adjust Last Operation panel.

steps.text: Radius 0.9 m.
Edit Mode.
Face select mode.
Click the top face.
steps.help: Tap the top of the cylinder.

steps.text: Face ▸ Inset Faces for the rim.
Thickness 0.06 m: the wall of the mug.
Face ▸ Extrude Faces, inward.
Move Z −1.8 m: deep, leaving a 20 cm bottom.
Edge select mode, for the loop cut.
Edge ▸ Loop Cut and Slide: the handle needs more rings.
steps.help: Edge ▸ Loop Cut and Slide, or Ctrl R.

steps.text: Click a side edge on the outside.
steps.help: Tap a vertical edge on the outside.

steps.text: Number of Cuts 3: four bands up the side.
steps.help: Number of Cuts in the panel.

steps.text: Back to Face select.
Click the top band on the right side.
steps.help: Tap the top band on the right.

steps.text: Shift-click the bottom band below it.
steps.help: Turn on ⇧ Shift, tap the bottom band.

steps.text: Extrude both faces outward.
Move Z 0.6 m: two stubs.
Edge ▸ Bridge Edge Loops joins the two stubs with a bar: the handle.
Edge select mode again.
Click an edge of the outer rim.
steps.help: Tap an outer edge of the top rim.

steps.text: Select ▸ Select Loops ▸ Edge Loops: the whole rim.
Edge ▸ Bevel Edges to soften the rim.
steps.help: Edge ▸ Bevel Edges, or Ctrl B.

steps.text: Width 0.03 m.
Segments 2: a rounded lip.
